tool_args.rationale: All five observations are positive and end by H = 0.48, far short of the forecast horizon of 23.8. The slow-horizon probe directly tests whether the response reverses and constrains its late-time magnitude before model confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the four-parameter dual-exponential law now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: At short horizons, the slow term mainly constrains the ratio of its amplitude to its time constant. Fits that agree on the pilot can disagree on the sign and magnitude at H = 23.8.
It can explain the positive short-window response but cannot represent a delayed sign reversal. The pilot does not distinguish these behaviors.
Finer time resolution is less informative than longer horizon coverage for separating the slow amplitude from its time constant.
